body.prompt: Story beat: she owns the roof as the song ends. Blocking at 0.0 s: she stands at the parapet, back to the city, the camera at her eye line. 0-1s: she breathes out and lifts her chin on the downbeat. 1-2s: she steps toward the lens on the beat, mouth closed. 2-4s: she stops, a small smile; the camera eases back and settles. Camera: medium shot, eye level, a slow pull back that ends at 2.5 s. She does not sing or speak. No text, letters or logos.
